channel.title: PHP Ledger news
channel.description: PHP Ledger is open-source, self-hosted double-entry accounting software with a simple cash point of sale for small businesses, built on PHP 8.5 and MySQL 8.4 and currently in development preview.

item.title: PHP Ledger 0.1.3-preview: account ledgers and optional modules
item.description: Evaluate visible running balances, reviewed opening cutover, bank reconciliation, CSV exports and owner-controlled POS modules in PHP Ledger 0.1.3-preview.

item.title: PHP Ledger 0.1.4-preview: clearer financial reports
item.description: Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet panels fit without horizontal scrolling. Account ledgers keep running balances and filters visible on tablets.

item.title: PHP Ledger 0.1.5-preview: accessible sample checkout
item.description: Product-specific POS quantity labels, visible no-JavaScript controls and clearer information about the project, privacy and temporary demo.

item.title: PHP Ledger 0.1.0-preview is available
item.description: The first PHP Ledger evaluation package includes company setup, receipts, expenses, balanced journals, reports and a sample cash point of sale.
